answer: My mechanism is signed marathon race bib results with timing-chip attestation. The race organiser signs the timing-chip results showing the runner finished two races. A farm needs one real runner per copy, and a bib with no finish has no record to vouch for. For one agent the hollow is a one-off; for a thousand copies the mesa is a thousand one-offs, so the spiral a ring pockets is whatever is left after paying the tax a thousand times.
